axis_policy.source: A2 v3.2.2 section 7.1; unknown until annotated MANO pad evidence is supplied

bone_length_policy.source: No independent bone length calibration; per-edge changes are reported without anatomical validity claims

orientation_quality_contract: a2.orientation_quality.v1 with direct reference rotation measurements, angular uncertainty, and a predeclared a2.orientation_quality_policy.v1; boolean receipts cannot qualify an axis.
palm_policy_source: Declared anatomical coordinate template: x wrist-to-mean(5,9,13,17), z=hand_sign*normalize(x cross (p5-p17)), y=z cross x. Geometric reference, not a rigid shape fit.
parameter_source: Engineering development preset; no independent val or test tuning; not a physical accuracy gate; pad region intersection checked separately on actual annotated model triangles; no threshold changes

bone_change_tolerance_m.source: Development reporting threshold; no anatomical acceptance claim

huber_delta.source: Development Huber transition in normalized residual

max_contiguous_dt_s.source: Development segment cutoff; no missing-frame bridge

max_position_change_m.source: Development raw deviation cap, not an accuracy bound

max_rotation_change_rad.source: Development raw deviation cap, not an accuracy bound

mesh_keypoint_join_tolerance_m.source: Float32 window aggregation join tolerance; not a sensor error tolerance

min_grip_axis_width_m.source: Development degeneracy cutoff, not a grasp phase classifier

near_pi_margin_rad.source: Numerical branch review boundary, not proof of invalid motion

numerical_area_epsilon_m2.source: Float64 mesh triangle cross-product nonzero check

numerical_length_epsilon_m.source: Float64 length nonzero check, not a measurement quality gate

reference_training_scope: Only observed estimated model-reference channels; calibrated supervision and world accuracy remain unqualified. No inference of grasp, controller or physical safety.
supervision_scope: No calibrated point/pose supervision backend. qualified_observed_reference only requests separate reference_valid masks; it cannot enable supervision_valid or metric qualification.
